name: Basic Container Diagram
description: Create a C2 container diagram showing major applications, databases, and services
helpContent: Generate a C2 (Container) diagram showing the main technical components of a system. Containers represent applications, services, databases, and other executable elements.
template:
Create a C2 Container diagram showing:
1. Applications: [List apps, web services, mobile apps]
2. Data Stores: [Databases, caches]
3. External Systems: [Third-party APIs]
4. Synchronous/Asynchronous Flows: [Communication patterns]

Each container should have clear responsibilities.

name: Microservices Containers
description: C2 diagram showing microservices, APIs, databases, and message queues
helpContent: Design container-level architecture for microservices. Show individual services, their databases, APIs, and asynchronous communication channels.
template:
Generate a C2 diagram for microservices with:
1. Services: [List each microservice container]
2. Data Layer: [Service databases, shared databases]
3. Message Queue: [Event/message broker]
4. API Gateway: [Entry point]
5. External Services: [Third-party integrations]

Show synchronous (HTTPS) and asynchronous (Events) flows.
